EDDM in New Windsor, NY

EDDM services for businesses and organizations in New Windsor, Orange County. In-house from our New Paltz facility since 1998.

EDDM Services for New Windsor

Every Door Direct Mail (EDDM) lets you reach every address on a postal carrier route in New Windsor without purchasing a mailing list. With a population of 27,400 and approximately 10,960 households across ZIP code 12553, New Windsor offers a substantial market for EDDM saturation campaigns. Cornerstone Services handles route selection, mail piece design, commercial printing, and all USPS paperwork from our facility in New Paltz — approximately 34 minutes from New Windsor. New Windsor is a busy commercial town adjacent to Newburgh, home to Stewart International Airport and the Newburgh Mall area. With major retail corridors and a large residential population, New Windsor is a strong market for both EDDM and targeted direct mail campaigns..

New Windsor is home to organizations like Stewart International Airport, New Windsor Cantonment, Town of New Windsor, and Newburgh Free Academy (shared district) — the types of businesses and institutions that rely on professional EDDM services.

New Windsor Market Profile

New Windsor is one of Orange County's larger communities with 27,400 residents, making it a prime market for EDDM saturation campaigns. The 10,960 households across New Windsor's carrier routes represent a significant consumer base — large enough to support ongoing monthly or quarterly EDDM programs with different messaging each round.

New Windsor is home to Stewart International Airport, New Windsor Cantonment, Town of New Windsor, and Newburgh Free Academy (shared district) — anchor institutions that shape the local economy and define the types of businesses that thrive here. EDDM campaigns targeting carrier routes near these organizations reach the households most likely to need related services, from restaurants and retail shops serving their visitors to contractors and service providers supporting their operations.

The most active EDDM users in New Windsor include Retail centers, Auto dealerships, Restaurants, Healthcare practices, and Professional services. These businesses benefit from EDDM's ability to reach every household on a carrier route without the cost of purchasing a targeted mailing list — particularly valuable in a large market where broad local awareness drives walk-in traffic and phone calls.

What's Included

Route Selection via EDDM Online Tool

We use the USPS EDDM Online Tool to select carrier routes in and around your target area. The tool pulls U.S. Census demographics — household income, age, size — so we can target the routes most likely to respond. Cornerstone manages the entire route selection process through our Business Customer Gateway account.

Mail Piece Design & EDDM Retail Indicia

USPS-compliant oversized postcards and flat-size mailers designed for maximum impact. Every piece includes the required EDDM Retail Indicia — the postal marking that replaces a standard stamp or meter mark on EDDM mail. Standard sizes: 6.5"×9", 8.5"×11", 6"×11".

Commercial Printing

High-quality offset and digital printing on heavy card stock. Full color, both sides. Cornerstone is listed in the USPS Printer Directory as a qualified mail piece printer meeting USPS automation and design standards.

PS Form 3587 & Postal Delivery

We complete PS Form 3587 (the EDDM postage statement) for each mailing, prepare facing slips, bundle by route, and deliver to the destination post office or Business Mail Entry Unit (BMEU). Postage: $0.260/piece (Retail) or $0.259/piece (BMEU DDU entry).

How the EDDM Process Works in New Windsor

The EDDM process for New Windsor starts with route selection using the USPS EDDM Online Tool, accessed through the USPS Business Customer Gateway. For New Windsor's 10,960 households spread across an estimated 27 carrier routes in ZIP code 12553, the tool lets us filter by U.S. Census demographics — household income, age distribution, and household size — so your mail reaches the New Windsor neighborhoods most relevant to your business.

For a full-saturation campaign covering all New Windsor carrier routes, you're looking at approximately 10,960 pieces at $0.260/piece (Retail) or $0.259/piece (BMEU DDU entry through the Newburgh facility). That puts the total postage cost between $2,839 and $2,850 — before printing and design. A complete all-in EDDM campaign for New Windsor typically runs $3,726–$4,603 including design, printing on heavy card stock, and postage. Most New Windsor businesses start with a partial-saturation campaign targeting 14–27 routes closest to their location.

Once routes are selected, we design your mail piece to meet USPS Marketing Mail standards. Every EDDM piece must include the EDDM Retail Indicia — a printed marking in the upper-right corner that replaces traditional postage. For New Windsor businesses, we typically recommend the 6.5"×9" oversized postcard — it's large enough to stand out in the mailbox but keeps per-piece printing costs manageable for large market campaigns.

Before delivery, we complete PS Form 3587 — the official USPS postage statement for EDDM mailings. This form documents the number of pieces, carrier routes, and postage due. For New Windsor campaigns, we deliver to the Newburgh Business Mail Entry Unit (BMEU) for streamlined single-facility induction — BMEU DDU rate is $0.259/piece vs. Retail's $0.260/piece as of July 12, 2026. The primary BMEU advantage at scale is operational: one induction point, no per-ZIP daily cap, no counter drops at multiple post offices.

EDDM for New Windsor Industries

Restaurants and food service businesses in New Windsor use EDDM to promote grand openings, seasonal menus, catering services, and weekly specials. An oversized postcard with appetizing food photography mailed to every household within a 2–3 mile radius of the restaurant generates immediate traffic. For New Windsor restaurants, we recommend starting with the 9 carrier routes closest to the business location, then expanding to the full 27 routes once response rates confirm the campaign is working.

Retail shops and boutiques in New Windsor use EDDM to drive foot traffic for sales events, new product arrivals, and holiday promotions. The key advantage of EDDM for retail is saturation — every household on the route receives your postcard, including residents who might not follow your social media or visit your website. For New Windsor retailers, a pre-holiday mailing 2–3 weeks before major shopping periods consistently generates strong ROI.

Healthcare and wellness providers in New Windsor — dentists, chiropractors, physical therapists, optometrists, veterinarians — use EDDM to announce new patient specials, expanded hours, and new services. Medical professionals benefit from EDDM's saturation approach because healthcare decisions are household-level decisions, and reaching every home on the route ensures you're visible to families actively looking for a new provider.

Auto dealers and automotive service businesses in New Windsor use EDDM to promote inventory events, seasonal service specials, and tire/brake campaigns. Automotive businesses benefit from EDDM's broad reach — vehicle ownership is nearly universal in Orange County communities, making every household on the carrier route a potential customer.

EDDM FAQ for New Windsor

How many households can EDDM reach in New Windsor?
New Windsor (ZIP 12553) has approximately 10,960 households spread across an estimated 27 carrier routes. A full-saturation EDDM campaign reaching every household costs approximately $3,726–$4,603 all-in, including design, printing, and postage. You can also select individual routes to target specific New Windsor neighborhoods at a lower cost.
What does an EDDM campaign cost in New Windsor?
For New Windsor's approximately 10,960 households, a full-saturation campaign runs $3,726–$4,603 including design, printing on heavy card stock, and USPS postage at $0.259–$0.260 per piece. Postage alone runs approximately $2,850. Partial-route campaigns targeting specific New Windsor neighborhoods cost proportionally less.
How far is Cornerstone from New Windsor?
Our New Paltz facility is approximately 19 miles (about 34 minutes) from New Windsor. We handle all EDDM design, printing, and postal delivery from our facility and deliver finished mail to the Newburgh BMEU for entry into the USPS system. Most New Windsor clients work with us by phone and email — no in-person visits required.
What is the EDDM Online Tool and do I need to use it myself?
The EDDM Online Tool is a USPS web application accessed through the Business Customer Gateway that lets mailers select carrier routes by ZIP code and demographic filters. For New Windsor campaigns, Cornerstone handles the entire route selection process — you do not need a Business Customer Gateway account or access to the EDDM Online Tool. We select the routes, prepare PS Form 3587, and deliver to the Newburgh BMEU.
What is PS Form 3587?
PS Form 3587 is the USPS postage statement required for every EDDM mailing. It documents the number of mail pieces, selected carrier routes, and total postage due. For New Windsor mailings, Cornerstone completes and submits PS Form 3587 as part of our service — you do not need to fill it out yourself.
What is the difference between EDDM Retail and BMEU entry?
EDDM Retail ($0.260/piece as of July 12, 2026) allows drop-off at any post office with no permit required. BMEU DDU entry ($0.259/piece) requires delivery to the Newburgh Business Mail Entry Unit and a postal permit, but removes the 5,000-piece-per-ZIP daily cap. At $0.001/piece difference, the BMEU advantage is now primarily operational — single induction point for large or multi-ZIP campaigns. Cornerstone handles BMEU logistics using our existing permit.
What EDDM mail piece sizes work best for New Windsor businesses?
The most popular EDDM formats for New Windsor businesses are the 6.5"×9" oversized postcard (cost-effective for large market saturation), the 8.5"×11" flat (maximum visual impact for menus, event promotions, and real estate), and the 6"×11" postcard (a balance of size and cost). All formats include the required EDDM Retail Indicia and are printed full-color on both sides on heavy card stock.
